requirements.text: The APB slave shall assert PSLVERR for any access to an address outside the mapped region 0x000-0x0FF.
requirements.label: CONFIRMED

scenarios.description: Read an address above 0x0FF and observe PSLVERR asserted for exactly one cycle.
Write an address above 0x0FF and observe PSLVERR with the write discarded.

requirements.text: PREADY shall remain stable once asserted until PENABLE falls.
requirements.label: CONFIRMED

scenarios.description: Drive a transfer with wait states and check PREADY stability across PENABLE.

evidence_types_required.exit_criterion: ap_pready_stable holds across the L0 suite

requirements.text: Byte strobes shall be honoured on writes. This requirement is self-evident and requires no test.
requirements.label: CONFIRMED

requirements.text: Reset shall return all registers to their defined power-on values within two PCLK cycles.
requirements.label: ASSUMED
requirements.assumption: Two PCLK cycles is the working default; the specification says 'promptly' without a figure.
requirements.consequence: If the real budget is one cycle, the reset test passes a design that is out of spec.

scenarios.description: Assert PRESETn mid-transfer and sample all registers two cycles later.
